sources.note: Dates c.1725 by internal evidence from Pope Benedict XIII; reports 106 armorial engravings and 107 genealogical tables, plus a list of Weigel's copper-illustrated publications.

notes: Major new branch. A non-annual genealogical/heraldic handbook existed within the Weigel-widow/Bieling orbit well before Gatterer's 1759 Handbuch. One catalogue explicitly reports a copper title/frontispiece, but its identity as the target Clio design remains unresolved. Copy descriptions disagree substantially on date and contents, so this may represent multiple issues/states or composite/reconfigured copies.

label: Peter Conrad Monath as Nürnberg scientific and copperplate publisher
date_note: Network facts span 1713–1730 in the current evidence.

features.value: bookshop/publishing/antiquarian business founded 1713; substantial output including copperplate, mathematical and astronomical works
Sámuel Mikoviny lived with Monath for six months in 1722 while learning copper engraving from Johann Georg Puschner; Monath later published Mikoviny's Nürnberg prospects

sources.citation: Virtuelles Museum Nürnberger Kunst, Peter Conrad Monath
Astronomie in Nürnberg, Peter Conrad Monath

notes: Provides production context for Eccard's Monath-published 1725 object study. No direct Monath–Weigel collaboration or identification of the Eccard plates' engraver has yet been established.

label: Döderlein taught Johann Tobias Köhler at Weißenburg
date_note: Johann Tobias Köhler was born 1720; exact school years not yet resolved.

relations.note: Biographical sources state that Johann Tobias received his learned preparation at Weißenburg under Rector Johann Alexander Döderlein.
Johann Tobias was Johann David Köhler's son and later contributed to/continued the Historische Münzbelustigungen.

sources.citation: ADB article Johann Tobias Köhler, via bavarikon

notes: This is a genuine intergenerational social/educational edge between Döderlein and the Köhler numismatic family. It does not prove Johann David Köhler borrowed Döderlein's 1729 method or text.
